description: A Minecraft mod that adds more gems and crystals, tools, and armour.

mods.name: Gems and Crystals
mods.description:
Gems and Crystals adds new gems, crystals, and ores to discover throughout your Minecraft world!

With this mod installed, you can find rubies, sapphires, topaz, amethyst, and quartz generating across different biomes and underground regions of the Overworld.

These materials can be crafted into tools, armor, and horse armor, giving you new progression options as you explore and mine.

Enjoy!

releases.notes:
### Update - June 17th 2022: **Version 1.4.0**

- Horse Armor! (Thanks for the suggestion!) Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald, Topaz, Amethyst, and Quartz Horse Armor have been added. You can craft them by making an "H" in the crafting table with the gem/crystal of your choosing, with a leather horse armor in the bottom middle slot of the crafting table. (Similar to the recipe for leather horse armor). Maybe configuration for the horse armor protection value will come in the future!

- Added forge tags to recipes to make the mod compatible with other gem mods.

- The code has been optimized. I removed lots of unnecessary code and modernized the methods used for ore generation and configurations.

- Other bug fixes.
